menu.title: Settings
menu.aiSub: Your key for stories and explanations
menu.furiSub: Furigana over the kanji in the interface
menu.grainSub: Paper texture in the sanctuary (off: smooth paper)

lang.title: Language
diary.title: Discovery diary

diary.lead.one: {n} of {total} words found · tap one to hear it
diary.lead.other: {n} of {total} words found · tap one to hear it

diary.rowSub.one: {n} word found · phrases, readings and kana
diary.rowSub.other: {n} words found · phrases, readings and kana

diary.noWordsSub: Every trip brings back a new word. Send a KANJŪ on a trip and come back here.
diary.anchorsSub: Words written with kanji you already have. Tap one to hear it.
diary.noPhrases: There is no phrase yet that you can read in full with this word.
diary.noPhr: You have not seen any phrases yet
diary.noPhrSub: Phrases arrive with the finds from your trips.
diary.phrSub: The phrases you have seen. Tap “How does it work?” to see the pattern.
diary.readsSub: Short texts made only of words you have found. Tap a line to see what it says.
diary.readDone: Read · read it again whenever you like
diary.readHelp: Tap a line to see its translation and the speaker to hear it.
diary.readAgain: Reading finished · every word counts one more encounter
diary.kanaSub: Kana light up with the words you find. The romaji of each kana turns off by itself once you get it right 3 times.
diary.kanaLegend: Lit: you saw it in a word · no romaji: you already read it on your own
diary.kanaFew: Find a few more words to practice their kana
diary.candoSub: A goal is reached when 80% of the words from its place are in review box 2 or higher.
find.againSub: You already know every word from this place. Your KANJŪ brought back a phrase to hear them again.
find.saved: It is now in your diary and joins the Dojo review.
find.againSaved: Every word in the phrase counts one more encounter.
find.knewToast: Marked as known: the Dojo will ask for it later on
dojo.doneToast: 修 Daily review done · {right}/{total} · +{ink} 墨
dojo.empty: First get a KANJŪ or find a word
dojo.freeAsk:
All reviewed. The next review arrives in {time}.

Free practice? (mastery does not change)
dojo.doneExp: your KANJŪ earned EXP for every kanji you got right
dojo.doneNote: What you missed comes back soon; what you got right, later and later. Missing never costs you anything.
dojo.hearMeaning: What does what you hear mean?
dojo.build: Build the word with the tiles
dojo.order: Put the tiles in order to make the phrase
level.title: What do you already know?
level.lead: This sets your reading help. If in doubt, pick the option above.
level.zeroSub: Romaji goes with each kana until you can read it on your own
level.kanaSub: Kana come without romaji; if you miss one, its romaji comes back
level.kanjiSub: All of the above, and kanji you already know move up fast in review
level.note: You can change it anytime in Settings.
guide.firstWord: Send your KANJŪ on a trip: it comes back with your first Japanese word
guide.pathReady: You finished a chapter of the Path: claim it in Missions
path.title: Sanctuary path
path.note: The Path is a guide: it never stops you from playing.
path.allDone: You walked the whole Path. The sanctuary is yours.
path.g.review: Review a word in the Dojo
path.g.acc: Get a kanji that contains a piece
tut.sheet: This is your KANJŪ. Tap it to meet it.
tut.pet: Tap it to pet it ♥. That grows its bond and its mood.
tut.train: Train it with a challenge. It learns its kanji and makes double ink for 1 hour.
tut.harvest: Your KANJŪ make ink 墨 while they live in the sanctuary. Collect it!
tut.trip: Send your KANJŪ on a trip: it comes back with a new friend and your first Japanese word.
tut.collect: Your KANJŪ is on a trip. When it's back, tap “Receive” to see what it brought.
tut.diary: Your first word is in the diary. Open it to see and hear it.
tut.fuseWeak: With {a} + {b} you can create {to}. First review them in the Dojo 修 or train them: {weak}
tut.fuseGo: You can now fuse {a} + {b} = {to}. Go to Fusion and join them.
tut.fuseNone: Send another trip: once you have two KANJŪ that combine, you'll make your first fusion.
tut.endReward: +50 墨 · +1 札 for the summoning altar
tut.endNote: Every trip brings a word to your diary and the Dojo 修 helps you keep it. Once you master a KANJŪ's kanji, it can evolve. The Sanctuary path waits for you in Missions.
round.free: Free games with its kanji: they give EXP, they do not advance the section.
round.notCounted: This training did not count: you need 80% right. Try again whenever you like!
round.asleep: The kanji is painted but asleep: it wakes up when you master {w}. Keep training!
round.bornSub: You painted it training “{title}”, and it woke up because you now know {w}.
round.inkInstead: You already had {k}: its ink became +{ink} 墨.
round.atGate: There was no room in the sanctuary: it is waiting at the gate.
round.skip: I know this · short test to skip this section
round.skipKana: I can read kana · short test to skip stage 0
round.testFail: Not yet: you need 80%. You can train this section or try again whenever you like.
book.hidden: A hidden kanji is half painted
book.title: Training notebook
book.lead: One page per section. What you paint while training comes to life.
book.asleep: Painted · wakes up when you master its word
